stem:
In each diagram, line g is parallel to line k, and line t intersects lines g and k.

Based on the diagrams, which statement about x is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The value of x is 180, because the labeled angles in each diagram are supplementary and the sum of the measures of supplementary angles is 180 degrees.

options.label: B
options.text: The value of x is 90, because the labeled angles in each diagram are complementary and the sum of the measures of complementary angles is 90 degrees.

options.label: C
options.text: The value of x is 44, because the sum of the measures of the labeled angles in each diagram is 180 degrees.

options.label: D
options.text: The value of x is 136, because the labeled angles in each diagram are congruent.

visual_elements:
Four diagrams showing parallel lines g and k cut by transversal t.
First diagram: angles marked 61° on lines g and k.
Second diagram: angles marked 123° on lines g and k.
Third diagram: angles marked 42° on lines g and k.
Fourth diagram: angles marked 136° on line g and x° on line k.
